svg.title: WiBoat dual-use radio architecture
svg.desc: Three WiFi interfaces on the Raspberry Pi each serve a different role: internal BCM for CSI sensing, ALFA #1 for TX injection, ALFA #2 for marina internet
svg.text: below: what each can broadcast / receive

g.text: LORAN used 90–110 kHz — completely different hardware. WiFi is 2.4 GHz.
But the CONCEPT (broadcast your position so others can find you) IS doable via WiFi beacon frames.
